opportunities.title: Wolfson Music Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scholarships for outstanding secondary school-age musicians in junior departments and funding for undergraduates to purchase instruments at nine musical conservatoires across the UK. Students are nominated by the conservatoire.
